title: Link songs and instrument banks
changes: List song IDs whose headers reference each instrument bank, with pagination and navigation to the corresponding sequence and back.
Preserve the selected key and CGB mute during navigation; do not infer individual program use or start playback.
validation: Synthetic Chrome unit rom-data-viewer-song-banks-synthetic-vb32mf9z checked pagination, duplicate IDs, absent data, navigation and existing audio and bookmark controls. Earlier zvakd4im failed because the test reused a Chrome profile; separate profiles corrected it.

Protected local-page unit rom-data-viewer-song-banks-local-ny618l30 checked all 454 bank-to-song references and both directions, preserving the existing embedded data. Docker parity unit rom-data-viewer-song-banks-docker-kry3o7x6 matched Python on synthetic input.
limitations: The local check used the existing embedded dataset because the original volume was unavailable; a bank reference does not prove a particular program or tone was used. Native Windows was not tested.
